Cliff located between n=96 (13.32 t/s) and n=104 (0.54 t/s), i.e. where llama-bench's n_ctx=n_gen leaves no headroom. Rate is identical past the cliff (~1.85 s/token uniformly, 25x penalty). Mechanism measured separately: GPU 99-100% busy, CPU ~94% idle, 0 MiB/s disk -> GPU-side work explosion in a Vulkan shader, NOT CPU fallback and NOT I/O.
